candidate.title: DroNC-Seq
candidate.scope: The middle DroNC-Seq workflow in the supplied Illumina poster crop, at schematic architecture scope, interpreted using Habib et al. (2017), PMID 28846088. DroNc-seq is the paper's spelling of this target. The top snDrop-Seq row and lower CITE-Seq row are neighboring catalogue workflows, not alternatives or branches of the assigned card. No equivalence between them is asserted. The left Single nuclei -> PolyA RNA vignette identifies the analyte rather than an additional extraction route. The main retained route runs from cell suspension through nuclei isolation, bead-containing droplets, lysis/capture, bead recovery, cDNA preparation and sequencing.

operations.label: Lyse

operations.label: Pool all beads from droplets

method_scopes.rationale: All six operations belong to the explicitly labeled middle row. The nuclei-isolation input history is retained in every downstream state. The paper confirms nuclei co-encapsulation and cDNA-based sequencing; generic cells wording and the mRNA readout caption are interpreted explicitly in corrections. The drawing's bead recovery before cDNA is preserved; the paper's additional pooling of post-RT STAMPs across collections is not substituted for that local operation. No operations from the neighboring snDrop-Seq or CITE-Seq rows are assigned to this method.
